errorCodes.text_occurrence_mismatch: Text matched an unexpected number of times
errorCodes.text_match_ambiguous: Several places matched about equally; nothing applied
errorCodes.text_match_low_confidence: A similar sentence exists, but it was not guessed
errorCodes.block_hash_mismatch: Block changed since it was read

errorGuidance.rejected_by_policy: Workspace policy blocked this call as sent. Retrying it unchanged will not help.
errorGuidance.conflict: The change conflicted with the document's current state and was not applied.
errorGuidance.validation_failed: A required field was missing, or the tool does not accept one that was sent. The agent has to fix the named fields and call again.
errorGuidance.stale_base_version: The document changed after the agent read it. The agent has to re-read it, or use the revision this error named, before retrying.
errorGuidance.operation_unsupported: This operation, or this combination of operations, is not supported as sent (for example block and text addresses mixed in one call). The agent has to change the request as the message says.
errorGuidance.operations_overlap: Two operations in the same call target overlapping text. The agent has to merge them into one operation or send them as separate calls.
errorGuidance.block_reflow: The new content changed how a neighbouring block parses. The agent has to end the replacement with a blank line and close any code fence, or replace the neighbouring block too.
errorGuidance.text_occurrence_mismatch: The text to replace appeared a different number of times than expected. The agent has to name a block or section, or use longer, unique text.
errorGuidance.text_match_not_found: The text to replace was not there, even ignoring whitespace and Unicode differences. The agent has to re-read the block below, copy its text, and resend addressed to that block.
errorGuidance.text_match_ambiguous: More than one place was about as close to the text to replace, so neither was changed. The agent has to resend addressed to one of the blocks below.
errorGuidance.text_match_low_confidence: The closest sentence differs in a number, identifier, code, URL, or by too much, so it was not changed on a guess. The agent has to copy the block's text exactly.
errorGuidance.text_not_found: The text to replace does not appear in the document. The agent has to re-read the section and copy its current text exactly.
errorGuidance.block_not_found: The addressed block no longer exists. The agent has to re-read the structure map for current block ids.
errorGuidance.block_hash_mismatch: The block changed after the agent read it. The agent has to re-read the structure map for its current content.
errorGuidance.section_not_found: No section matched the requested heading. The agent has to choose one of the suggested sections.
errorGuidance.scope_denied: The client's token lacks the permission this tool needs. Retrying will not help; the client needs a token with that scope.
errorGuidance.not_found: The target does not exist in this workspace, or this client cannot see it.
errorGuidance.workspace_role_insufficient: The connected account's workspace role does not allow this. A workspace admin has to grant the role.
errorGuidance.internal_error: The server failed while handling the call. The agent can call again; if it keeps failing, give an operator the time of the call.
errorGuidance.workspace_access_denied: The connected account or token cannot open this workspace. A workspace admin has to add the account, or the client needs a token for this workspace.
errorGuidance.restricted_library_denied: The item is in a restricted Library this client may not read. Retrying will not help unless a workspace admin changes the Library's access.
errorGuidance.unsupported_retrieval_mode: The tool does not support the requested read mode. The agent has to call again with a supported mode.
